title: Display trusted Command Incident next action and optional due time in existing read-only Incident Detail
goal: Fill CAP-CMD-106's explicitly required coordination/next-action read gap in the already implemented local Incident Detail. Reuse existing optional IncidentOverviewOwner, strictly revalidate returned scoped source, label missing actions unknown and never execute a Class-2 action.
invariants: No new action source or authorization engine: only optional Command IncidentOverviewOwner sourced after fresh Incident selection + CanRead may return an action.
A missing Command overview/action/due remains explicitly unknown; no inferred next step, reminder or created Task/Action Request.
Action text <=256 bytes UTF8 without controls; optional due <=64 bytes RFC3339Nano nonzero, forbidden if action is empty; reject inconsistent/trust-violating owner payload without partial HTML.
Command Incident.read and existing narrow overview policy must not grant Investigate Case, Alert, Govern Result or other owner permissions.
Previous PR #213 review head remains immutable; sibling PR #188/#187/other historical SHA unchanged.
security_properties: Only independently scoped source includes IncidentID, tenant, environment, provenance source version and observed timestamp in fresh owner projection; no client field may assert action.
HTML template escapes all source action text, denies malformed and cross-tenant responses before output; revoke Incident read prevents optional Command source read.
No source text or response-token contents in Query URL; synthetic local Basic remains test-only, not production IAM.

migration.rationale: Two optional read-only fields on existing in-memory owner view and existing HTML; no stored Incident schema migration.

rollback.strategy: Revert new optional fields and HTML next-action display while preserving old overview and Incident Detail owner chain.
verification: Existing read-only detail and Command/Investigate same-origin journey still work.
Legacy owner without overview or action remains explicitly partial.
